messages:
Lina: Proposing a targeted entitlement sweep for service principals (svc-*/infra-*) next Tue. Objective: remove Admin-like bindings & stale KMS grants, but keep customer-managed keys untouched unless explicitly approved.
Tom: good. scope = all envs or prod-first?
Lina: prod-first with staging dry-run. We'll do canary batches in prod after owners ack.
Asha: Can you share the exact detection heuristics? want to reproduce locally.
Lina: We'll flag principals with any of: iam:Admin policy, iam:CreatePolicy, kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion, kms:CreateGrant, kms:*Crypto* permissions. Also last_activity < 60 days used as delta.
Kari: For KMS, recommend cross-ref list-grants + CloudTrail events for GenerateDataKey and Decrypt calls to infer actual use.
Lina: Agreed. CLI snippets for staging:
```
aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name svc-... 
aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/... 
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=GenerateDataKey
```
Tom: Rollback plan? automated rebind or manual doc?
Lina: Both. We'll snapshot terraform state (tagged by audit_id) and ship a small reprovision script to reapply bindings if the smoke-tests fail. Automated rollback will run if smoke fails or if oncall signals.
DevOpsBot: Reminder: schedule change windows using infra-change workflow. Attach calendar event and post 10m before each canary batch to #eng-oncall.
Asha: Smoke tests idea: run a short suite hitting token-signing, secret fetch for 10 svc accounts and run key decrypt flows. Failures open auto-rollback ticket INFSEC-5123-ROLLBACK.
Kari: Exclude principals referenced in any open incident or vuln ticket. We had one case where a temporary escalation got removed prematurely last quarter.
Lina: Noted. We'll query Jira for open tags and exclude principals mentioned in linked incidents.
AuditBot: KMS audit retention policy = 365 days. All prune actions will include an audit_id and will be logged with actor and diff.
Tom: Timing: target 02:30 UTC for canary to hit low traffic window. Agree?
Asha: works for EU/US. APAC may be heavier but ok for a small batch.
Lina: Canary cadence:
- Day 0: dry-run report CSV (principal, role, last_activity_ts, owner, suggested_action)
- Day 1: small canary (3% matches) monitor 1h, smoke tests
- Day 2: expand 20% if green
- Day 3+: continue phased rollout and post-run summary
Kari: Add a bypass flag for principals with recent MFA bypass or just-elevated sessions.
Lina: Added. Also discovered 1 stale grant on a deprecated key during reconnaissance; created ticket INFSEC-5123 to trace owner.
Asha: For customer-managed keys: ensure explicit opt-in before any change.
Lina: Absolutely. We'll auto-skip any key labeled cust:managed unless the owner signs off in the ticket.
Tom: After sweep, run randomized sampling of 250 endpoints + s3/kms decrypt flows to catch silent failures.
Lina: Will include sampling results in final report. I'll attach dry-run CSV and runbook to INFSEC-5123 by EOD Fri. Ping me if you want early access.
Kari: Thanks team. lean and safe approach :thumbsup:
